difference_from_existing.difference: Daily uncertainty premium on 79 days; here direction at 5-120 minutes after the release with a realised-surprise positive control, up to ten Kalshi classes.
Daily Goldstein-Li-Wang lead-lag of control odds; here one-hour jump episodes across eight themes with minute-level ETF returns and extended-hours costs.
Stock cross-section earnings markets; here index, bond and small-cap ETFs and macro and policy markets.

mechanism_description: R: pre-release Kalshi implied expectation drift and gap to the previous print, hawkish lean, short TLT through the release. J: one-hour Polymarket odds jumps, mapped by theme to a primary ETF, continuation or reversal over 15-240 minutes.
objective: T-20261007-02: do prediction-market odds (Kalshi pre-release expectations for macro releases; Polymarket one-hour odds jumps for policy, Fed, shutdown, recession and election themes) predict US ETF returns at 5-240 minute horizons net of costs, 2024-01-08..2026-10-06?

sources.applicability: Why R may have little: Kalshi is about consensus except headline CPI and the policy rate; release classes and intraday reaction are the paper's own.
